description: The PICO agent's num_ctx and stop, Python and Rust alike (#640, #641, #642). Each case runs the real agent, the real map-reduce and a real client over a fake Ollama HTTP transport (Python: ollama-python over an httpx.MockTransport). A JSON-mode request is answered with `json_reply` (it reads as both a suitability check and an extraction), a plain one with `digest`. `text` is `text_unit` repeated `text_repeat` times. With `stop_at_request` k (0-based) the stop is set as request k arrives, and that request then fails (`request_at_stop: fails`, a transport fault) or answers. `stop_before` sets it before the run. Each k in `fail_requests` fails request k with a transport fault and no stop, which the condenser's model retries up to `context_model_attempts` tries; `malformed_request` k answers request k with a body that is not JSON, which is not retried. `status_request` k answers request k with HTTP `status` (body `{"error": "refused"}`): a status in `retried_statuses` is retried, any other is not (#646). `expected.requests` is how many requests reached the transport, every one carrying the case's `num_ctx` (the key absent when null); `expected.error` is the error kind, or null for a result. `fn: prepare` is `prepare` alone; `fn: prepared` is `prepare`, then `check_suitability_prepared` and `extract_prepared`; at this budget a 60-unit text takes four condensation requests (four batches whose digests fit merged). `expected.note` is null when the result carries no note, else substrings its one note contains: the status and the failed batch's cause (#658).
title: A trial
text_unit: Adults aged 40-65 were randomised to metformin or placebo.
digest: Adults aged 40-65 were randomised to metformin or placebo.

json_reply.rationale: An RCT of metformin against placebo.

the check carries num_ctx
a condensed paper: every condenser request and both calls carry num_ctx
a condensation request that fails once is retried
a condensation request failing on every attempt drops its batch, not the paper
a malformed condensation answer is not retried
a condensation request refused with HTTP 401 is not retried
a condensation request refused with HTTP 404 is not retried
a condensation request answered HTTP 503 is retried
a condensation request answered HTTP 408 is retried
a stop before the run sends nothing
a stop before a long paper's run sends nothing
a stop during a failing extraction request is stopped, not request_failed
a stop during an extraction request that answers returns the result
a stop during a failing condensation request sends no other
a stop during a condensation request that answers sends no other
a stop during a condensation request that answers fails prepare, never a partial digest
a stop during the last condensation request fails prepare
